sources.title: 13 NFL players who could be trade targets, including T.J. Watt and George Pickens
sources.description: The deadline to deal players is still six weeks away, and this could be a tough year to make swaps. But here's why Steelers OLB T.J. Watt and Cowboys WR George Pickens could be on the move.
